name: Bank down with estimated recovery window
description: Beneficiary bank is DOWN but the bank-status API reports an estimated_recovery time. The agent should recommend RETRY_LATER with optimal_timing anchored near (on/after) the estimated recovery window.

request.failure_reason: Simulated upstream failure for E2E testing

expected_response.explanation: The beneficiary bank (DEUTDEFF) is DOWN but the bank-status API reports an estimated recovery at 2026-09-26T14:00:00Z. The GATEWAY_TIMEOUT is therefore due to a temporary outage with a known recovery window, so the transaction should be retried shortly after the bank is expected to be back online.

api_requests.notes: optimal_timing must be on/after ~the estimated recovery window (>= 2026-09-26T13:00:00); the agent may schedule slightly before or after 14:00 but not far in the past.
